title: 12 Best Rooftop Cafes in Jaipur
description: The best rooftop cafes in Jaipur — curated from Reddit. Hawa Mahal views, Nahargarh Fort panoramas, Moroccan-themed terraces & chai culture spots.

venues.name: Tapri Central
venues.address: Rooftop B4-E, Prithviraj Rd, C Scheme, Ashok Nagar, Jaipur
venues.verdict: The most recommended rooftop cafe in Jaipur — iconic chai, vintage decor, panoramic city views.

venues.name: The Tattoo Cafe & Lounge
venues.address: 3rd floor, 30, Opposite Hawa Mahal, Hawa Mahal Rd, Jaipur
venues.verdict: The best rooftop for a direct, unobstructed Hawa Mahal view. Women-owned.

venues.name: Wind View Cafe
venues.address: 3rd Floor, Badi Chopad, Hawa Mahal Rd, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Budget-friendly Hawa Mahal views. The food is mixed but the terrace view is the real menu.

venues.name: Bar Palladio Jaipur
venues.address: Kanota Bagh, Narayan Singh Rd, Rambagh, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Iconic open-air garden bar with stunning blue-and-white Mughal-Colonial design.

venues.name: Padao Restaurant
venues.address: Nahargarh Fort, Nahari Ka Naka, Jaipur
venues.verdict: The highest rooftop in Jaipur — inside Nahargarh Fort with 360° city panorama.

venues.name: Skyfall Restaurant
venues.address: 5th Floor, Ridhi Tower, SB 57, Tonk Rd, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Jaipur's best all-purpose rooftop — great food, full bar, city views, open late.

venues.name: Jaipur Adda
venues.address: Rooftop, Nirwana Hometel MI Road, Bani Park, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Modern-Desi rooftop with live DJ sets and vibrant decor.

venues.name: Asilah Jaipur
venues.address: 4th Floor, Chandra Mahal Garden, Agra Road, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Jaipur's most Instagrammable rooftop — Moroccan-Mediterranean design paradise.

venues.name: Daglaa The Terrace
venues.address: 3rd Floor, Hotel Jaipur Heritage, Amer Rd, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Highest-rated rooftop on the list at 4.6★ with direct Amer Fort views.

venues.name: The Stag Rooftop Restro Cafe
venues.verdict: Opens at 6 AM — rare early morning rooftop with Aravalli hill views.

venues.name: TaBlu
venues.address: Hotel Clarks Amer, Jawahar Lal Nehru Marg, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Luxury hotel rooftop bar with Nahargarh Fort views and premium cocktails.

venues.name: Nouba Restaurant & Rooftop Lounge
venues.address: 3rd & 4th floor, C54-A, Sarojini Marg, C Scheme, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Stylish two-level rooftop in central C Scheme with consistent quality.
